# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `ttmi` MCP server pointing at TTMI's hosted endpoint (`https://ttmi.ai/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with TTMI sign-in — no API key to configure.
- Logo: absolute URL `https://ttmi.ai/icon-512.png`; the file could not be downloaded when the plugin was added.
